question: Use R and the WGCNA package to identify co-expression modules from combined RNA and protein expression data, and test which modules are associated with disease status (the 'Disease' column in Pheno.csv). Merge the two datasets by row-binding RNA and protein features. Report the Pearson correlation of each module eigengene with Disease and its p-value.

expected_output.guidelines: Correlation and Pvalue per module must match the reference within +/-0.05 if the same number of modules is found; if module counts differ, the Spearman rank correlation of ranked absolute correlations (top-N, N = min module count) must be >= 0.6 and the sign of the highest-|correlation| module must match the reference. Row order, module color labels, column order, and header labels may differ.
Color grid of module-trait correlations with numeric values overlaid in each cell; axis labels, color scheme, and styling may differ.
